iteration_0.issue: Lack of input validation for model parameters
iteration_0.impact: Invalid parameters (negative values, zero population, or initial infected exceeding population) could cause simulation to behave unexpectedly or output nonsensical results.
iteration_0.solution: Add explicit checks in the SIRModel and EpidemicSimulation constructors to validate parameter ranges and raise informative exceptions if invalid.

iteration_0.issue: No way to customize simulation parameters at runtime
iteration_0.impact: Users must edit the source code to change population size, infection rate, etc., reducing usability and flexibility.
iteration_0.solution: Add a command-line interface or environment variable support to allow parameter customization without code modification.
